# Chess clock

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/chess-clock/

Run two player clocks with a chosen starting time and increment. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Start a five-minute game with a two-second increment and switch turns after each move.

## Limits and checks

Keep this browser tab active for reliable display and audio. Elapsed time is computed from timestamps rather than timer ticks.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
